By what percentage did the proposed hybrid retrieval architecture improve Exact Match (EM) accuracy on the benchmark dataset compared with the dense-only baseline?
answer: The proposed hybrid retrieval architecture (BM25 + Dense Bi-Encoder + Cross-Encoder Re-Ranker) improved Exact Match (EM) accuracy on the benchmark dataset by 14.6% compared with the dense-only baseline (increasing EM accuracy from 61.2% to 75.8%).

question: What GPU cluster configuration (number and model of GPUs) and total training duration, in days, were required to train the 13-billion-parameter model?
answer: The 13-billion-parameter model was trained on a dedicated hardware cluster of 128 NVIDIA H100 (80GB SXM5) GPUs interconnected via 400 Gbps InfiniBand, with a total training duration of 18.5 days.
